comment: java.lang.Thread's members, a HOST_CALLABLE_CLASSES type (ClojureInteropLowering) kept out of
the main file: rontolisp's binary reads both, and the browser playground's Web Image build
excludes this one (pom.xml, the web profile's --exclude-config). The svm-wasm platform has no
thread parker or stack-overflow check, and registering Thread's public methods makes them
reachable, which fails that build. ClojureHostImageTypesTest reads the two files as one.
